limits: Bounded heterogeneous sequential pilot, not statistical accuracy or model ranking.
A/B/C compare skills under current tools/harness, not historical inference/server state.
Contract/static pass never proves model semantics or Kodi runtime behavior.
Token/cache usage is cumulative SDK reporting, not billing or unique context.
Repeated inputs are observational and can be necessary.
No operator intervention inside model trials; between-trial harness fixes are retained with provenance.
Qualification reports are additional annotations; original events, assessments and prototype reports remain unchanged.
Raw model prose can contradict a valid empty draft. It is preserved as unverified, never used as factual report input.
Explicit final fixture paths do not cover every prose filename or line reference; independent review found inaccurate coordinates.
Three prototype PASS review reports were scope errors: final qualification keeps contextual review PARTIAL, including empty valid drafts.
scope: 13 bounded sequential trials across evolving Phase 6 revisions, followed by separate final-code qualification of preserved records; not a same-version benchmark.
